notes.title: Retro dungeon crawler Brany Skeldalu gets a Linux version and source code re-release
notes.notes: Gates of Skeldal (Czech: Brány Skeldalu) originally released in 1998 and recently it gained a Native Linux version along with a source code re-release.Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/05/retro-dungeon-crawler-brany-skeldalu-gets-a-linux-version-and-source-code-re-release/
